gist.summary: The automated October 8, 2026 README update refreshed Latest News and the light and dark star-history charts. Recent Apps is refreshed separately when an app is published.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli updates a little README noticeboard beside two star-history charts and a potted code-plant. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, wearing tiny reading glasses, with chunky retro sprites, prominent lime green (#ecf874), soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, and retro gaming vibes.
